4394ee1a.text: Hey. So... about the shrinking thing.

853f5b12.text: I need your help with my stand. You still work for me, right? Well...

9954aefb.text: I need you to shrink super small. Tinier than germs. So tiny that you won't even be able to see me.

40f01cc7.text: You'll be in the tinyverse. Where all the germs and creatures live.

4687078a.text: What? I don't think I want to do that, though.

341c7688.text: Come on. I'll even... give you a very good paycheck. Maybe.

d61f3f90.text: Okay, how about 500 dollars? Is that good enough?

f3727f00.text: Okay, fine. Only since you're my friend.

35aa035c.text: Okay, Jim. Where's this shrink thing?

e2a1db18.text: It's not a watch this time.

2a0148db.text: You have to get in my shrink ray. Yeah. I built a shrink ray.

784dd6da.text: You stand on the platform, and I push the button that shrinks you.

4802a7d5.text: You'll wear a suit. It has a radio in it, so I can talk to you the whole time.

8290a3c0.text: Whoa, slow down. Where even is this shrink ray, anyways?

09da4dbb.text: So this is my secret place. Nobody knows my code at all, or anything.

3ec125cf.text: I keep it down here so nobody wrecks my research.

b62bd14d.text: So. The reason why I want you to do this is because I'm testing an experiment.

4d1d2d22.text: To see if they would try to attack you. I want you to send pictures of what they would look like.

09b87961.text: I'm gonna give you a camera.

b9f0590f.text: Oh! And the suit. Here, put this on. It's got the radio in it.

9be12d34.text: Testing, testing. Can you hear me in there?

b66966af.text: Okay. Step onto the platform. When I press this button, you'll shrink down into that cage.

bf132987.text: There are things in there too small for anyone to see. Not me. Not you. Not with your eyes, anyway.

059a7271.text: Okay! Hold still. Here goes nothing!

8176f982.text: Whoa... you there? Can you hear me? What do you see down there?

3f5b272b.text: Take pictures! Take pictures of everything!

e4c33155.text: Wait... what is that? What IS that?!

cbafdb74.text: It's HUGE! Take a picture! TAKE A PICTURE!

c04b09a7.text: Good job! I just need 4 more different creatures.

23cc518a.text: Hi there! You need a picture?

1b4830bb.text: Get me 5 Paramecium snacks, then we'll talk.

77ac9e36.text: Ok, you can take your picture.

960356de.text: Not now. Somebody's at the door.

c0452968.text: Come on, let's take your car!

899eca8a.text: Hey, are you coming with me or not?

31627706.text: Nope. I already said I'd help him.

b30cb6df.text: Is anything trying to attack you yet? Be honest.

cf6e176e.text: Hey! Did that thing just bump you?! Is it attacking?! Get a picture!

e4b94195.text: Uh... hey. Why is everything swimming away?

ca9ce9da.text: Get me some Paramecium snacks, then we'll talk.

ecee754a.text: Hey! I'm building a rocket ship.

cc6733db.text: As you can see, it's not fully done.

93b22fba.text: Nobody up here likes bug food. Nobody. I'm going broke.

07bb2697.text: So we're gonna fly to a new planet. One that actually likes bug food.

bf7712a7.text: Can you help me find the missing pieces? There are five of them around the moon.

95b9c4a7.text: Welcome to Mars! See those guys? Robot people. And they LOVE bug food.

80765b61.text: But this isn't any type of bug food. This is ALIEN bug food.

99863c57.text: Oh, and your old watch... well, it was broken.

f4a0a1d2.text: Well. It just looks better. That's all.

a7786e9a.text: But it makes a new sound! Anyway, your shift starts now. Twelve to one.

3c1a6d31.text: Shrink down, get those alien bugs, and chop 'em up into bug food. They're over by the glowing plants.

9972ed4b.text: Okay, now that you have got all the bug food, you can go find a home.

635348b7.text: I know we lost our home on Earth. I know.

0bcb11fe.text: But you'll need your own place to sleep. You can't keep sleeping at mine.

6045d0d1.text: I already booked one. As soon as I got on this planet.

51ffc1f1.text: Here's your paycheck. Now go get some sleep.

bb5821cc.text: You want a house? I'm selling this one for a hundred alien coins.

4e72e274.text: What is a hundred alien coins? I only have fifty dollars.

15dcae4f.text: Dollars? Ha! You can convert your dollars into alien coins at the alien converter.

e9bbf090.text: He's right by my house. Go talk to him.

4fbd90f5.text: This beauty? Two thousand alien coins.

f2c10f03.text: Alien coins? I only have dollars.

eafe62fb.text: Then go see the alien converter. He's by the dome house over there.

52f4ac7d.text: This one's fifty alien coins. It's... kind of small.

fa6b8698.text: I don't have alien coins. Just dollars.

8d08b598.text: The alien converter's by the dome house. He'll swap 'em for you.

3e5d1c7c.text: Seven hundred fifty alien coins. Hex houses are VERY in right now.

e14d009a.text: Two thousand alien coins. Final offer.

fb828c08.text: The Dome Sweet Dome! A hundred alien coins. Deal?

6608ff12.text: A hundred alien coins. You don't have enough yet.

f980901b.text: I need to go to the converter first.

d4933c88.text: Still a hundred alien coins. Come back when you're richer.

abbc33e0.text: Selling this house for fifty alien coins! It's kind of bad. It's not that big...

4d8819e4.text: ...but it's yours if you want it.

f073739a.text: Fifty alien coins. You don't have enough. So... no.

e09def6d.text: You're out of dollars, friend. Nothing to convert.

cab07d53.text: Back again? Welcome to the Alien Currency Converter.

2e5e223d.text: Welcome to the Alien Currency Converter. One dollar, one alien coin. No refunds.

7bd54bbd.text: What amount of money do you want to convert?

a4e89e47.text: Five pieces! They're glowing, you can't miss 'em.

433ee781.text: You can only carry one at a time, so bring 'em back one by one.

03438a1e.text: Look for the yellow beams of light!

1e8fa315.text: I'm bolting on what we've got. You find the rest.

59a4af18.text: Oh, it's the bug guy's friend. Hi.

e971c10f.text: Still selling bugs? On the MOON?

baa850de.text: I can only carry one at a time.

b921cdbc.text: You did it! It's done! Get on, get on!

795fc50c.text: Whoa! You got knocked out! Careful, those alien bugs bite!

f3f53bab.text: I don't have any bug food to cook.

fd74fd01.text: Still for sale! Come back when you've got the coins.

7db9145d.text: NOM. NOM. ALIEN BUG FOOD: DELICIOUS.

eaf3c6e2.text: BEEP. THIS IS MY FIFTH BOWL.

9b515755.text: RATING: TEN OUT OF TEN BOLTS.

7542dd05.text: Hey! You! You looking for a house?

f289944e.text: No bug food?! Go shrink down and chop at least three bugs, then cook 'em!

8f036637.text: Shift's not over yet! Get shrinking!

57f3c1f7.text: Twelve to one. You know the drill.

a87fd377.text: The bugs are by the glowing plants!

bda41a17.text: Cook all the bug food first! The Bug Cooker 3000's right there.

1c7f7164.text: No bug food? Shrink down and get some!

5439a3e5.text: There you go. All converted. Pleasure doing business.

4e00ab1c.text: Pleasure doing business, human! Here are your keys.

04e8533f.text: Not yet. I wanna check out the house first.

cdaac53b.text: An alien table. It's floating. Kind of.

9a7218aa.text: The fruit is glowing. I'm not eating that.

cca8186b.text: Didn't sleep... Up all night... working...

5cf7f6a4.text: An... and kill those..... alien ants and.....

9190758f.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm so tired.

5a147f40.text: I have your watch. And the world will be mine.

f892a626.text: Your new watch. Every time it beeps... it tells me where you are.

68e7f197.text: You wanna eat pizza? Or should I say... alien pizza.

5b3e2fcf.text: The pizza here is different. But good.

a3ff4952.text: Jim, you know the alien, right?

365849d9.text: Well... I had a dream he had my watch. I'm scared that he will shrink the Earth.

7e565f52.text: He's not going to. He doesn't even know where we are. Ok, buddy?

0d47ca22.text: And here is some money. Fifty dollars. You can probably buy a new house.

bb819fec.text: Super comfy. It's shaped like a bean.

c1592357.text: Alien cartoons. I don't get them. But they're funny.

2ba77186.text: It's got like a million channels.

c47a651b.text: This TV is bigger than my old house.

9cd0ee0c.text: Alien snacks. And more alien pizza.

9879abe7.text: Alien fish. That one is looking at me.

e8760393.text: They glow in the dark. Cool.

16b3859c.text: High score: ZZXQ. Some alien is really good at this.

a9855bda.text: It's bubbling. It's purple. It's great.

7c9bf36c.text: No, no, no... this can't be happening.

5a08b680.text: Nice watch, by the way. It led me right to you.

3ed6abcd.text: Why do you want this? Wh—

f295730d.text: So that's why I'm going to. And when I do...

1ec0a72d.text: Every one of you humans is going to pay.

24d53d3d.text: Steve, I need help with the place Earth will be.

d2029bca.text: When I get back... I'm cutting the hand off you.

f91ee831.text: When I was a kid... I always wanted to play with the kids. You humans.

de52d3c0.text: But you guys just pushed me away. And called me a loser.

6961730d.text: Jim, I'm stuck in this alien ship. Steve got me.

68e4dee4.text: Ok. I will find you. Ok? Just don't let him get that watch.

7304eac6.text: YOU IDIOT! What have you done!

4d612315.text: Sit. Down. Next time I won't be this nice.

b137ee5e.text: It's locked. I can hear Steve and Alex talking in there.

a8be1e26.text: Found under the sand? What sand?

e218e9be.text: Where do you think you're going?

a41f31e7.text: What is going on? Why is everything blocky? Did you do this?

1d698ded.text: I'm sorry, Bob. Trust me. I'm calling Jim right now.

8b209aba.text: People are dying. You know that, right...

fc25cdef.text: It doesn't matter what happened. I'm coming to get you in the rocket. Where are you?

93908170.text: Ok. Stay where you are. I'm coming.

96cb2fc2.text: Okay. Suits on. They make you stronger, and a lot harder to hurt.

e47585fb.text: They've got jetpacks too. Watch your fuel. It runs out.

1c718866.text: This is a nuke. It has to go inside XXX5.

5f3f83b3.text: All the way inside. It's the only way.

bc72d93d.text: Dang it. Worse than I thought.

40ba4e8d.text: Ok. You know what to do, guys.

d984205e.text: It's XXX5. It's a dangerous thing... that will destroy the universe.

ffdea804.text: It doesn't matter. What does is I got to put the nuke in here.

3952a606.text: Jeff, what are you doing here? Ok, we got to get out of here!

5418ada4.text: Yes... but is Bob ok? And Jeff?

db93aa61.text: I'm sorry, bud. At least you have me.

2861f7bb.text: That's all of them! Great job! Ok, now I'm going to make you big again.

ba659856.text: I'm gonna fix this, I promise. But it could take a while.

70751d33.text: You can't just float around out there. Find somewhere safe to stay.

f1e23add.text: Hey! I heard all that. Your friend can't make you big again?

9ebf19c8.text: Then you can't stay out here. Stuff out here eats things our size.

b696e981.text: You got me those snacks. So come live with me in Mite Town. I've got a spare lint bed.

b523137c.text: It's ok, everybody! This is my friend. He got stuck small, so he's staying with me.

5f94f250.text: Come on, I'll show you around. That's the snack market. And those are the lint beds. Super comfy.

d349b405.text: Oh no. The giant tardigrade! And it looks hungry!

dee042f2.text: You did it! You're a hero!

c1436fb0.text: When the shrink ray broke, a piece of its crystal broke off. It fell into the Tinyverse.

94ea9870.text: It glows purple, deep down. If you find that shard, I can reverse the ray. And make you big again.

5e93ffcb.text: The shard should be deep down. It glows purple.

3189436d.text: I'll ride my Paramecium. Stay close!

79d6f96d.text: We did it! Let's go home!

960ae789.text: There you are! Hop on, it's right down there!

b8918365.text: It's dark down here. Swim near the little guys, they light up!

88371140.text: Hydras! Don't let the tentacles grab you!

46af1d0c.text: Wait... you found TWO pieces? That's enough crystal for two!

e615aad7.text: Two? Who's the other one for?
